starting_state: validated cold rest, continuous native oldTime in memory
primary_timing: external monotonic end-log increments; exclude actual native write steps; native ClockTime integer seconds retained
checkpoint_policy: real adjacent triplets, no purge; retain all native fields and _0 histories plus uniform/time; strict restart remains uncertified because native e/K histories are not output. No thinning of the intrinsic native restart state.

native_signals.activation: case-local OptimisationSwitches, MPI cwd at case so native debug merges local controlDict
native_signals.write_signal_rule: send SIGUSR1 to master during step preceding target write; native Time::operator++ reduces flag to all ranks at next increment
native_signals.stop_signal_rule: send SIGUSR2 to master during step999; native Time::operator++ sets endTime and writes at1000
native_signals.step_watchdog: if step1001 start detected, kill all worker processes before completing an extra timestep
native_signals.wall_watchdog: terminate every solver/launcher PID at600s, no extension or retry
